Pod events bind the mechanism verbatim: 'Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.2.186:9555" within 1s: context deadline exceeded' and 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' -> 'Back-off restarting failed container'. The adservice Deployment configures livenessProbe: initialDelaySeconds=1, periodSeconds=1, timeoutSeconds=1, failureThreshold=1 (grpc port 9555), i.e. a single 1s probe timeout kills the JVM container before it can listen on 9555; the baseline service (paymentservice) uses initialDelaySeconds=5 with default 10s/3 thresholds, confirming the timing values are anomalous. Port/protocol are self-consistent (containerPort 9555 = PORT env = Service targetPort 9555; adservice speaks gRPC), and all other 10 pods are Running with 0 restarts, so the fault resides in adservice's liveness probe timing configuration.
